events.title: Samsung Galaxy S20 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy S20 — 120 Hz displays and 5G across the line — COVID-era flagship launch.
events.about: The Galaxy S series remained Android's volume flagship counterweight to iPhone. 120 hz displays and 5g across the line — covid-era flagship launch. Developers testing Android builds routinely validated on Galaxy S hardware as the default non-Pixel reference.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy S20 continued Samsung's annual Android flagship cadence.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy S devices set the hardware bar millions of Android users and developers encounter.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed consistent premium hardware for testing flagship features each year.
